name: Laya

based_on.note: Not Qwen: an encoder (ModernBERT-large, 395M) plus a trained decision head.

summary: 421M open decision model (ModernBERT-large encoder) from Convai; about 33 ms per decision. Multilingual (322M, 100+ languages) and typed-decisions checkpoints too. Its own card says the base checkpoints are near chance on typed decisions until fine-tuned. Decision model: it answers typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) with probabilities through a Jev-compatible /v1/systemone endpoint. It does not chat or write text.

practical_baseline.reason: Decision models are not ranked by the chat-model baseline policy; pick by hardware and API.
